description: VaneUI is an open-source React component library for Tailwind CSS v4 with a boolean props API: write <Button primary lg filled> instead of variant="filled" size="lg". 40+ typed components, CSS variable theming through ThemeProvider, dark mode, React 18 and 19, MIT license.
rules: Set visual options with boolean props: <Button danger lg filled>. Never pass variant="filled", size="lg" or appearance="danger" strings.

Pass at most one value per category: size (xs, sm, md, lg, xl), appearance (primary, accent, secondary, tertiary, success, danger, warning, info), variant (filled, outline, ghost), shape (pill, rounded, sharp).

Do not pass props that are already defaults. Button is already sm, primary, outline and rounded; Card is md, primary, outline and rounded; Row and Stack already have gap. Write <Button filled>, not <Button primary outline rounded filled>.

Import exactly one stylesheet: '@vaneui/ui/css' (prebuilt, no Tailwind setup) or '@vaneui/ui/vars' in a Tailwind CSS v4 build, with '@vaneui/ui/tokens' and @source "../node_modules/@vaneui/ui". Never import both css and vars.
Wrap the app once in <ThemeProvider> at the root. themeDefaults, extraClasses and themeOverride only apply inside a provider.
Set app-wide defaults with ThemeProvider themeDefaults. Components with sub-themes use the nested form: { button: { main: { filled: true } } }. Others use the flat form: { badge: { success: true } }.
Prefer VaneUI props over Tailwind classes: fontBold not className="font-bold", textCenter not "text-center", pill not "rounded-full", itemsCenter not "items-center".
Do not override themed colors or sizes with className: use danger, not bg-red-500, and size props, not gap-* or text-sm. Keep className for things no prop covers, such as width or custom positioning.
Layouts are desktop-first. Use mobileStack or tabletStack on a Row to stack it on smaller screens, and mobileHide, tabletHide or desktopHide to hide content below that width.
Chip and Badge default to the neutral secondary appearance, and Text, Title, SectionTitle and PageTitle inherit color from their parent. Add an appearance prop only when you want a specific color.
Use href to render a link: Button, Card, NavLink and Badge render an <a> when given href. Do not wrap a Button in a Link, and use NavLink for sidebar and header navigation.
For dark mode, set data-theme="dark" on the <html> element. Components need no code changes.

Import components from '@vaneui/ui'. Per-component entry points such as '@vaneui/ui/button' also exist. Check prop names and defaults on https://vaneui.com/docs or with the @vaneui/mcp server before guessing.
